title: Identity Platform — OIDC ID Token Claims (v1, FROZEN)
description: The stable ID Token claim contract (Phase 2D.8). An ID Token is consumed exactly once, by the requesting client itself, for client-side identity display — it is STRUCTURALLY REJECTED as an API bearer credential (token_use discriminator + missing tenant_id/jti). See docs/OIDC_ARCHITECTURE.md §2 and docs/IDENTITY_EXTERNAL_API_CONTRACT.md §4.

iss.description: REQUIRED. Same issuer as the access token.

sub.description: REQUIRED. security_user.id — the SAME value the co-issued Access Token's own sub carries. Public (non-pairwise) subject.

aud.description: REQUIRED. The REQUESTING OIDC CLIENT's own Application.clientId — never a resource-API audience. Never mix with the Access Token's aud semantics.

exp.description: REQUIRED. Short — meant to be consumed immediately after issuance, not stored/reused.

nonce.description: REQUIRED whenever the /authorize request supplied one (mandatory for every OIDC request in this platform). Echoed verbatim.

token_use.description: REQUIRED. A resource server MUST reject any bearer token carrying this value.

x-forbidden-claims: amr (not fabricated — genuinely unavailable data, Phase 2D.8)
